increment: G7 qualifying ranking, starting order and the session sequence
limits: racemain.cpp and raceresults.cpp are pinned for provenance and the qualifying excerpt is compiled; the rest of those files is not built.
Championship points and results-file handling around this code are not ported.
The original's qualifying flow, one driver per session cycling the field, is not yet driven by the window, which runs a single solo qualifying session.
The plan assumed qualifying times order the grid directly; the original instead ranks single-driver runs and lets a race read that ranking through its starting order.

The window only runs the human's qualifying session; the weekend model accepts a run from any driver but there is no flow yet for watching the AI drivers qualify in turn, so a ranking-based grid can only be completed for a one-car field.
Championship points and persistence across launches are not implemented; a weekend lives as long as the window.
A GPU timing test fails while the game is running, because the frame inflates under contention; the suite figure above was measured with the GPU free.
scope: Semantic port of the original qualifying ranking and the starting order a race selects, compared against a verbatim excerpt of the newly pinned results code
